lead.headline: Four unnamed traders held 69.7% of sell positions in one mid-Atlantic power futures contract in early 2026, a record
lead.number: Top-4 share of the short side, PJM Western Hub off-peak day-ahead futures on ICE: 69.7% in 2026 Q1 (peak week 71.8% on 2026-03-10) vs 47.4% in 2024 Q1, but only about 5 points over the 2014-15 highs.
lead.watch_out: One exchange only: the same product on Nodal Exchange sits near its low (~32%), 2024 is the series' lowest point, and the CFTC never names the traders.
